label: PF Backlog 182
title: Auto tier creation: recommend + validate agent->model from the catalog (per-agent needs)
body: Given agent needs (tools/reasoning/structured/min_output/min_context/modality per agent, from agent cards + agent_requirements) and the model catalog, AUTO-BUILD/validate a tier: pick the best-fit model per agent (rank by fit, then cost/speed), flag not-good assignments with reasons, and offer alternates. Writes config/model-tier.json profiles. Human accepts or edits; never silently rewrites. Feeds the dashboard tier-creation UI.
